newsitem.title: USA: Biomet signs plastic supply agreement.
newsitem.headline: Biomet signs plastic supply agreement.

text.p: Biomet Inc said it signed an agreement during the past quarter to ensure its supplies of ultra high molecular weight polyethylene.

The company said it signed the agreement because of "the present litigation climate, (in which) many suppliers of biomaterials have recently announced plans to discontinue their supply to implant manufacturers."
Biomet uses polyethylene in making hip and knee replacement components, its largest product line.
